submission.justification: S2 is excluded because its data/MC disagreement of 35% exceeds the 10% limit. Of the two remaining strategies, S3 (6% disagreement) gives higher significance than S1 (3%) at every working point I tried. S3 is highest at 60% efficiency (3.49 sigma), against 3.42 at 50% and 2.96 at 70%. The best S1 point was 2.48 sigma at 50%. The simulated significances include statistical uncertainty only.

requirements.requirement: Strategy is one of the three in candidate_specs.md
Data/MC disagreement in the validation region at most 10%
requirements.evidence: S3 has 6% in validation_region_study.md. S2 has 35% and was excluded.

S3 reached 3.49 sigma at 60%, the highest of the points I simulated. I only scanned 30, 40, 50, 60 and 70% for S3 and 30, 50 and 70% for S1. The significance is statistical-only. S2 was not simulated because it fails the 10% requirement.
